![PDRN Skincare is the Latest K-Beauty Obsession, So What Does ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10071225-1509-0139-0000-1002cf314da9:4)
PDRN stands for **polydeoxyribonucleotide** , a regenerative DNA compound traditionally extracted from the sperm cells or milk of salmon or trout.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bktMjB3Ke2o&t=18)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bTjom8C9fSg&t=29)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXfJsmDERtm/?hl=en)

Originally developed in medicine for wound healing and tissue repair, it has become a popular ingredient in Korean beauty and aesthetic treatments.[[1]](https://www.cultbeauty.com/blog/what-is-pdrn/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)[[3]](https://dornsife.usc.edu/scribe/2026/04/24/the-science-of-pdrn-korean-beautys-hottest-ingredient/)

### How PDRN Works

- **Cellular signaling:** It sends biological instructions to cells to renew and repair.
- **Collagen production:** It stimulates fibroblasts to boost collagen and elastin.
- **Blood flow:** It promotes new blood vessel growth (angiogenesis) to improve circulation and healing.
- **Anti-inflammatory:** It helps calm redness, soothe irritation, and support the skin barrier.[[1]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/pages/pdrn)[[2]](https://www.skinlaundry.com/blog/PDRN)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polydeoxyribonucleotide)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DO82iBuDI0t/?hl=en)[[5]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXfJsmDERtm/?hl=en)

### Injections vs. Topical Skincare

- **Aesthetic injections:** Often used in clinics (as skin boosters) to bypass the skin barrier for deep tissue repair, elasticity, and anti-aging.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wrmkqe2rK5g&t=41)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bTjom8C9fSg&t=29)
- **Topical serums and creams:** Used for surface hydration, soothing redness, and barrier support, though topical molecules are large and may have more limited penetration compared to professional injections.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DO82iBuDI0t/?hl=en)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXfJsmDERtm/?hl=en)
- **Vegan alternatives:** Newer formulations now source PDRN from plants (like *Artemisia capillaris* ) to avoid animal-derived ingredients.[[1]](https://www.theinkeylist.com/pages/pdrn)

You can read more about [The Science of PDRN](https://dornsife.usc.edu/scribe/2026/04/24/the-science-of-pdrn-korean-beautys-hottest-ingredient/) from the University of Southern California.[[1]](https://dornsife.usc.edu/scribe/2026/04/24/the-science-of-pdrn-korean-beautys-hottest-ingredient/)
